messages:
Tom H.: Hey team — customer (MedicaCorp) asked for a POC evidence packet + signed pen-test letter. Also asking whether Dedicated capacity changes pricing for the POC. Can we get a quick plan?
Raj K.: Thanks — quick q: is POC going to use hosted API or do they require private/VPC? that changes lead time.
Tom H.: They said 'we prefer hosted but may require dedicated if SLA/throughput looks good'. goal is 2-week POC, ~50k tokens/day.
Alice P.: I can assemble a slim proofpack. I need to know required artifacts — typical list I send: SOC 2 Type II report (redacted), ISO27001 cert, pen-test attestation letter (signed), network diagram (high level), encryption/key flow, logging/retention matrix, data residency note.
Mia S.: +1. For pen-test letter — we have a template that says "no exploitable findings at time of test" and a signatory block for the pen-test vendor. If they want vendor report we can provide attestation only (we don't redistribute full 3rd-party reports without consent). Also need to confirm whether we should redact IPs/hosts.
Nora (Legal): FYI we need customer to sign an NDA before we share unredacted artifacts. For the signed pen-test letter we can provide our template; include vendor name + date. If MedicaCorp wants vendor PII removed, that's ok.
Tom H.: Is there a cost delta if we run hosted vs Dedicated for the 2-week POC? sales needs a number to quote.
Raj K.: Short answer: hosted = standard usage charges; Dedicated = reserved capacity + monthly commit. For a short 2-week POC, Dedicated is usually more expensive unless they commit to monthly. Rough estimate: hosted ~ $X/day for 50k tokens (ballpark), Dedicated setup (min month) ~= ~3-6x that for the first month depending on pool size. I can send a sketched quote.
Alice P.: I'll put together the evidence ZIP. Plan to include redact guidance and a short readme. Can someone confirm the customer contact and dropbox preference?
Tom H.: Contact is sara@medicacorp.com. They prefer a presigned dropbox link or SFTP.
AuditBot: Evidence bucket created: https://s3.console.aws.amazon.com/s3/buckets/rw-evidence-medica-1745019876 — presigned upload enabled for 72h (owner: alice.p).
Mia S.: Blocker flag: customer mentioned "on-prem or air-gapped option" during the call. If they require Private (on-prem/VPC) that's a deployment lead time of ~4-6 weeks plus security review. Need to surface that ASAP — POC timeline would slip.
Tom H.: Important — we need to clarify on the call tomorrow whether "on-prem" was a hard requirement or aspirational. If aspirational, proceed with hosted POC and handoff Dedicated/Private later.
Raj K.: Actionable next steps from infra side: I can provide a minimal Dedicated sizing for 50k tokens/day and a hosted cost estimate by EOD. Alice — can you start the proofpack template and include the pen-test template?
Alice P.: On it. I'll drop a first draft to the evidence bucket and ping Sara. Also will attach the pen-test template for signature.
Nora (Legal): I'll review the pen-test template before final send. If MedicaCorp wants the vendor to sign, confirm who the vendor contact is.
Tom H.: I'll confirm vendor if they ask. Also ask customer whether they can accept redacted SOC2/pen-test attestation vs full report.
Raj K.: FYI for the pricing note to customer — offer hosted POC with a short burst Dedicated eval if they want to see throughput; that avoids an upfront month commit for many banks.
Alice P.: Draft uploaded: evidence/readme.md, evidence/soc2-redacted.pdf, evidence/iso27001.pdf, evidence/pen-test-attestation-template.pdf. Link in bucket. I left a checklist in the readme.
Tom H.: Great — I'll confirm requirements on tomorrow's call. Thanks all :thumbsup:
Mia S.: If call indicates strict residency/on-prem we should loop Eng-Platform and Security for a scoping session. I'll create a ticket after the call.
Raj K.: Quote + hosted vs dedicated breakdown posted to thread by 1745019900.
Tom H.: Closing note — target to have signed pen-test letter + evidence zip to customer within 72h after call if they accept hosted.
